# package bacnet

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-otfp/protocols/bacnet"
```

Package bacnet fingerprints BACnet/IP (ASHRAE 135 Annex J) over UDP.

Detection sends a confirmed ReadProperty for the Object\_Identifier of the wildcard device object (instance 4194303), which a BACnet device answers with a unicast ComplexACK carrying its real device object identifier — an answer that reaches a probing socket directly, unlike the broadcast I-Am that Who-Is draws. A Who-Is is sent as a fallback. Any BVLC/NPDU/APDU the device returns — ComplexACK, Error, Reject, Abort, I-Am or a BVLC-Result — identifies BACnet, since no other protocol frames an Annex J message.

In identify mode the device object's identity properties are read: object name, vendor name and identifier, model name, firmware revision and application software version.
